literal: To friendship, the essential part is the right of intimacy; and to that, becoming agreeable is the noble ones' duty.
translation: The defining feature of true friendship is the freedom to take liberties. It is the duty of the noble to gracefully accept such intimacy.
modern: நட்பின் முக்கிய உறுப்பு, நண்பர்கள் தமக்குள் உரிமை எடுத்துக்கொள்வதாகும். அந்த உரிமைக்கு இனிமையாக உடன்பட்டு நடப்பது சிறந்தவர்களின் கடமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core of long-standing friendship as 'கெழுதகைமை', which is the right to take liberties without hesitation. The word 'உறுப்பு' compares this right to an essential limb, showing that friendship cannot function without it. Furthermore, the word 'உப்பு' (literally salt) is used metaphorically to mean being agreeable or adding a pleasant taste. Therefore, it is the duty of noble people to warmly accept and be agreeable to the liberties taken by their old friends.
